translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Jehova Nyasaye owacho niya,
“Wer, yaye in dhako ma migumba,
in ma ok inywol nyithindo;
wer matek, ka igoyo koko gi ilo,
in mane muoch ok okayi;
nimar dhako ma migumba nobed gi nyithindo,
mangʼeny moloyo dhako man-gi dichwo.
Ket kar hembi obed maduongʼ,
yar ragengʼ mar hembi obed malach,
kendo kik idog chien;
tud tondene obed maboyo
bende igur loyene motegno.
Nimar ibiro medori malach kichomo
bat korachwich kendo kidhi bat koracham;
ogandani noma ogendini pinjegi mi
dagie e mier madongo makoro owe gundini.
“Kik ibed maluor; nikech ok iniyud wichkuot.
Kik ibed gi luoro mar yudo wichkuot; nikech ok nojari.
Wiyi nowil gi wichkuot mane iyudo ka in nyako,
kendo ok inichak ipar chandruok mane ineno kane ibedo dhako ma chwore otho.
Nimar Jachwechni e chwori,
Jehova Nyasaye Maratego e nyinge midendego,
Jal Maler mar Israel e Jaresni;
iluonge ni Nyasach piny ngima.
Jehova Nyasaye nodwogi ire,
mana ka dhako manoyudo osejwangʼ,
kendo ma chunye nigi lit ahinya, en dhako mane
okend ka nyako ngili kae to bangʼe ojwangʼ,”
Nyasachi ema owacho mano.
“Kuom kinde manok asejwangʼi,
to koro abiro duogi ira gi kech mangʼeny.
E kinde mane an gi mirima mangʼeny ne apandoni
wangʼa kuom ndalo manok,
to koro gi ngʼwono mochwere an-gi kech kuomi,”
Jehova Nyasaye ma Jaresni ema owacho.
“Kuoma to ma chalona mana gi ndalo mag Nowa
kane akwongʼora ni pi mane oimo piny ok nochak obedie kendo.
Omiyo koro asekwongʼora ni
mirima ok nochak omaka kodu kendo,
bende ok anachak adhawnu.
Kata ka gode biro yiengni,
kendo gode matindo ibiro muki,
to herana kuomu mosiko ok noyiengi,
bende singruokna mar kwe ok nogol,”
Jehova Nyasaye man-gi kech kuomu owacho.
“Yaye dala maduongʼ misando,
ma ahiti oyiecho maonge ngʼama hoyo,
abiro geri gi kite motegno,
kendo miseni anager gi gik mabeyo.
Anager kuondeni mag gige lweny gi rubi,
dhorangeyeni to naketie kite ma nengogi tek,
kendo ohingani naketie kite mabeyo.
Nyithindi duto nopuonj gi Jehova Nyasaye
kendo ginibed gi kwe maduongʼ.
Ibiro geri e tim makare:
Ok nichak ine tij achuna; kendo onge gima iniluor.
Bwok maduongʼ ibiro ter mabor kode;
kendo ok ginisud machiegni kodi.
Kapo ni ngʼato omonji,
to ok nobed ni an ema aore;
to ngʼato angʼata momonji nochiwre e lweti.
“To ne, an ema ne achweyo jatheth mula,
machwako chuma e mach,
kendo loso gige lweny makare ne tijno.
An ema asechweyo jaketh mabiro kelonegi chandruok;
onge gige lweny molosi ne in mano hinyi,
kendo inilo buche duto modonjnie.
Ma e pok ma jotich Jehova Nyasaye yudo,
kendo ma bende e gweth ma asemiyou,”
Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
